technique_name: Give a list of environmental issues in India
description: In India, some of the primary environmental issues are air pollution, water pollution, illegal logging, declining forest cover, soil degradation, chemical fertilizers, and pesticides, over-exploitation of natural resources, water scarcity, gas emissions from factories, and climate change.  Additionally, India suffers from solid waste management problems due to rapid urbanization, resulting in air and water pollution, and loss of biodiversity.
